exec(open('/app/tmp/test_model.py').read().split("r=random.Random")[0])
import random,time,fractions
r=random.Random(991)
for trial in range(5):
 fib=random_fib(r,8)
 S=5;stride=r.choice([26,28,30,32]);caps=[r.randrange(200,2000) for _ in range(S)]
 u={(b,e):naive_cost(fib,b,e) for b in range(128) for e in range(b+1,min(128,b+stride)+1)}
 best=None;bestcuts=None;paths=0;t=time.monotonic()
 def rec(i,b,cuts,peak):
  global best,bestcuts,paths
  if best is not None and peak>best:return
  if i==S:
   if b==128:
    paths+=1
    if best is None or peak<best:best=peak;bestcuts=cuts[:]
   return
  left=S-i-1
  for e in range(b+1,min(128,b+stride)+1):
   if 128-e<left or 128-e>left*stride:continue
   use=u[b,e]
   if use>caps[i]:continue
   rec(i+1,e,cuts+[e],max(peak,fractions.Fraction(use,caps[i])))
 rec(0,0,[0],fractions.Fraction(0))
 req={'op':'compile','fib':[{'prefix':s.canonical_prefix(v,l),'hop':h} for v,l,h in fib], 'capacities':caps,'max_stride':stride}
 ans=s.compile_request(req)
 if best is None:assert ans=={'status':'infeasible'},(trial,caps,stride,ans)
 else:
  got=fractions.Fraction(ans['peak']['num'],ans['peak']['den']);assert got==best,(got,best,bestcuts,ans['cuts'])
 print('trial',trial,'stride',stride,'paths',paths,'best',best,'brute cuts',bestcuts,'status',ans['status'],'cuts',ans.get('cuts'),'sec',time.monotonic()-t)
